en.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Release Date Locked — Early Access Details Revealed
en.summary: Master Chief's next adventure is almost here, but not everyone gets to jump in at the same time. We break down the precise launch windows for Halo: Campaign Evolved.
en.body:
The wait for **Halo: Campaign Evolved** is nearing its end, and the iconic Master Chief is ready to suit up once more. While the official global launch is set for July 28, 2026, dedicated fans eager to dive into the action can secure up to five days of early access. This premium perk is reserved for those who opt for either the **Premium** or **Collector's Edition** of the game.

For players who've pre-ordered or purchased the **Premium Edition**, priced at $69.99, early access kicks off on July 23, 2026. This edition not only grants access to the base game ahead of the general public but also includes the **Alpha Halo Armory Pack**, featuring five unique Master Chief skins and eight weapon skins. Further sweetening the deal, pre-ordering the Premium Edition also unlocks the **Foundry Armory Pack**, though specific contents for this pack have not yet been fully detailed.

The **Collector's Edition**, while offering a similar early access window, is available only in select regions, making the Premium Edition the more widely accessible option for early birds. This tiered release strategy aims to reward players who invest in the higher-tier editions, offering them a head start on the latest chapter in the storied Halo saga.

## Countdown to Launch

Timing is everything when you're counting down the minutes to a new Halo experience. The early access period for **Halo: Campaign Evolved** begins on July 23, 2026, at 11 AM EDT. This translates to 8 AM PDT, 10 AM CDT, 3 PM UTC, 4 PM BST, and 5 PM CEST. For those who choose the Standard Edition or are playing via Game Pass, the official global release date is July 28, 2026, with the same timing: 11 AM EDT (8 AM PDT, 10 AM CDT, 3 PM UTC, 4 PM BST, 5 PM CEST).

This staggered release ensures that early adopters get their time with the new campaign, while the broader player base can look forward to the official launch just a few days later. The information regarding these precise launch timings has been confirmed via the official Xbox app on PC, providing clarity for players worldwide.

## What This Means for Spartans

The anticipation for a new Halo campaign is always palpable, and the prospect of early access only amplifies the excitement within the community. For many, the Halo franchise represents more than just a game; it's a cornerstone of their gaming identity, and being among the first to experience a new story is a significant draw. The tiered release, while a common practice now, still sparks discussion among fans about value and access. However, the addition of exclusive cosmetic packs like the Alpha Halo Armory Pack provides tangible benefits beyond just an earlier start, appealing to collectors and those who enjoy customizing their in-game appearance. The community is abuzz with speculation about the new missions, potential story beats, and how the latest installment will build upon the rich lore that has captivated players for over two decades.

## What's Next

With early access commencing on July 23, 2026, and the global launch following on July 28, 2026, players have clear dates to mark on their calendars. Keep an eye out for post-launch reviews and community discussions as everyone experiences the new campaign together.
